items.title: Tyler Huntley: Unlikely for Thursday
items.text:
Head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Huntley (toe) "probably" won't play Thursday versus the Jaguars, and the Ravens then will "see how it goes from a long-term standpoint."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joe Fagnano: Chance to play Thursday
items.text:
Coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Fagnano (knee) "is fighting through a couple things" but has a chance to play Thursday against the Jaguars.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jake Ferguson: Has chance to play Sunday
items.text:
Head coach Brian Schottenheimer said Monday that Ferguson (ankle) has a chance to play Sunday at Indianapolis, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Matthew Stafford: Managing arm soreness
items.text:
Stafford left the locker room after Sunday's 24-9 win over the Charger with a bag of ice wrapped to his right arm, and Rams coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday that the quarterback has been dealing with some arm soreness, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emanuel Wilson: More competition for work
items.text:
Wilson is welcoming back Zach Charbonnet (knee) and Jadarian Price (chest) to the Seahawks backfield for Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
